cards.front: تو تا کی همچو سرو از ما کشی سر
cards.back:
How long will you be like
A cypress tree,
And lean your lovely head
Away from me?

cards.front: الهی تو بگشا دری از بهشت
cards.back:
O God, I beg you, open wide
The gates of heaven

cards.front: هرگه که گلی تازه به صبحم بنمود
cards.back: Each new flower opening in the morning light,

cards.front: با درد تو درمان نپذیرد دل من
cards.back: My heart will take no drug to dull this pain,

cards.front: در جوانی قدر خود نشناختم
cards.back:
I didn't know my value then, when I
Was young, so long ago;

cards.front: دلا در باغ حسنش عندلیبم
cards.back:
Heart, in his beauty's garden, I –
Like nightingales – complain,

cards.front: گرم بوسی دهی از لعل پرنوش
cards.back:
If you should kiss me with
Your ruby lips, my dear,
I'd be your slave and wear
Your earring in my ear.

cards.front: دلم همچو سر زلفت درهم
cards.back:
My heart is tangled like thick curls
And no one hears me grieve;

cards.front: صبا باز آ که درمانم تو داری
cards.back:
Sweet breeze return to me, you bear
The scent of my belovèd's hair.

cards.front: ای برده آتش رخ تو آب و رنگ گل
cards.back:
Your face usurps the fiery glow and hue
of roses;

cards.front: عهد کردم که ازین پس ندهم دل به خیال
cards.back:
From now on I have sworn
I won't let dreams deceive me,

cards.front: خوابی خوش است اینکه شب دوش دیده‌ام
cards.back:
How sweet sleep is! I dreamed I saw
My friend last night,

cards.front: بیا بنشین مرو در خواب امشب
cards.back: Come here a moment, sit with me, don't sleep tonight,

cards.front: بگو چگونه دهم شرح آرزومندی
cards.back:
How can I tell you what I want from you
When you'll be angry with me if I do?

cards.front: به باغ شد دل من صبحدم به گل چیدن
cards.back:
At dawn my heart said I should go
Into the garden where
I'd pick fresh flowers, and hope to see
His flower-like beauty there.

cards.front: گر آید نسیمی ز سوی نگار
cards.back:
Suppose a breeze should bring to me
My lover's scent –

cards.front: الهی تو بگشا به لطفت دری
cards.back: O God, be kind, and open wide Your door,

cards.front: یاری که همه میل دلش سوی وفا بود
cards.back:
My friend, who was so kind and faithful once,
Has changed his mind now, and I don't know why;

cards.front: مگر با ما سر یاری نداری
cards.back: Have all your feelings for me gone?

cards.front: عاقبت کار فروبسته خدا بگشاید
cards.back:
It will be God who opens up,
At last, these bonds that hamper me,

cards.front: یاد باد آنکه عزیزان همه با هم بودیم
cards.back:
How sweet those days when we were still
together;

cards.front: جانا چه باشد ار دل ما را دوا کنی
cards.back:
How would it be, my soul's love, if you healed
My heart for me,

cards.front: به عالم غیر تو یاری ندارم
cards.back:
In all the world, my love,
I've no one else but you;

cards.front: چرا به کار من ناتوان نپردازی
cards.back:
Why is it you neglect me so? Why is it
You never pay your captive wretch a visit?

cards.front: بیشتر خلق جهان در پی جاه و درمند
cards.back: Most people in the world want power and money,

cards.front: تا به چند آن غمزه از من دلربایی می‌کند
cards.back: His glances trap my heart within their snare,

cards.front: چرا کردی مرا از دل فراموش
cards.back:
Why, in your heart, have you forgotten me
And put your loving arms round someone new?

cards.front: نگارا رسم دلداری نداری
cards.back: You don't know how you ought to treat a lover,

cards.front: به رخ چون ماه تابانی به قد چون سرو آزادی
cards.back:
Your face is like a shining sun,
your stature's like a cypress tree
That grows in paradise, and I'm
your slave; I've no wish to be free.

cards.front: هنوز از بادهٔ وصل تو مستم
cards.back:
I am still drunk that you were here,
and you were mine,

cards.front: ای که پنداری که ما را جز تو یاری هست، نیست
cards.back:
I know you think that there are other friends for me than you:
Not so.

cards.front: این جور و جفای چرخ تا چند
cards.back:
How long will heaven's heartless tyranny
Which keeps both rich and poor in agony
Go on?

cards.front: دوش در خواب چنان دید دو چشم بختم
cards.back:
Last night I dreamed I saw with fortune's eyes
The garden of my hopes revive its reign;

cards.front: گل رفت و وداع گل ز جان باید کرد
cards.back: The roses have all gone; "Goodbye," we say; we must;

cards.front: به کنج مدرسه‌ای کز دلم خراب‌تر است
cards.back:
Here, in the corner of a ruined school
(More ruined even than my heart), I wait

cards.front: گفتم که دگر چشم به دلبر نکنم
cards.back: I swore I'd never look at him again,

cards.front: در باغ برهنه گشتی ای شاهد شنگ
cards.back: You wandered through my garden, naked and alone

cards.front: در دیده خیال توست ما را همه جا
cards.back: Wherever my eyes look I see your image there,

cards.front: من دوش قضا یار و قدر پشتم بود
cards.back: Last night, my love, my life, you lay with me,

cards.front: مشکل که به درد عشق درمانم نیست
cards.back: My love's an ache no ointments can allay now;

cards.front: ای دل ستم از یار جفاپیشه بسیست
cards.back:
I told my heart, "I can't endure this tyranny!
He's nothing, no one! What's this bully's love to me?"

cards.front: ای دل بنشین و با غم یار بساز
cards.back:
My heart, sit down, welcome love's pain,
and make the best of it:

cards.front: بر درد دلم طبیب ار آگاه شود
cards.back:
I feel so heart-sick. Should my doctor hear,
He'll sigh and groan and want to interfere:

cards.front: زردم ز فراق روی دلدار چو شمع
cards.back:
Your face's absence leaves mine waxy-white,
like a candle;

cards.front: پروانه‌صفت پیش تو در پروازم
cards.back: I'm like the moth that flutters round a light,

cards.front: زنهار بکوش تا توانی ای دل
cards.back:
Always, whatever else you do, my heart,
Try to be kind, try to be true, my heart:

cards.front: ای دل به جهانت ار بود راز و نیاز
cards.back:
My heart, if you have words you need to say,
Be warned! Keep would-be confidants away.

cards.front: از عمر عزیزم حاصلم چیست بگو
cards.back: What has this life we long for given me? Tell me.

cards.front: اگر به بند زمانه کسی شود محبوس
cards.back:
When someone is imprisoned for a while
Men ask about his fate, and want to know his crimes;

cards.front: با ندیمان خوش و صحبت یاران لطیف
cards.back:
A picnic at the desert's edge, with witty friends,
And tambourines, and harps, and lutes, is very sweet.

cards.front: ای دل گل روی یار دیدن چه خوش است
cards.back: To see the blossom of his face, my heart – how sweet;

cards.front: تدبیر و صواب از دل خوش باید جست
cards.back: A happy heart's the place for plans and piety,

cards.front: تا بر درت ای دوست مرا باری نیست
cards.back:
If I can't even get beyond your door,
that's hard for me –

cards.front: بیچاره کسی که از وطن دور شود
cards.back: Pity the wretch, forced from her native land,

cards.front: از دل نالم یا ز فلک یا ز فراق
cards.back: Shall I complain of absence? Of my heart? Or of the skies?

cards.front: گل گفت به خنده صبحدم با بلبل
cards.back: Laughing, the rose said to the nightingale one day,

cards.front: از تهمت خصم نیستم آسوده
cards.back: My enemies' glib lies are never done –

cards.front: شیراز خوش است خاصه در فصل بهار
cards.back: Shiraz when spring is here – what pleasure equals this?
